name: runman
description: Strava training analytics and plan generation, with a fixture-tested shared science core.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @runman/core && npm run build -w @runman/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @runman/core && node --test api/_lib/*.test.js api/*.test.js && npm run test -w @runman/web
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @runman/core && npm run typecheck
